description: Apotheosis is the backbone: affixes, gems and world tiers apply to every weapon and armour piece,
including Simply Swords, Cataclysm and Aether gear. Accessories (Artifacts, Relics) add a second layer in Curios slots.
Pick a direction - the quests below are guides, not requirements. Mixing is fine.
&bWhy it matters:&r Explains the build guides below; none are required.
